questions: Should the strings be sorted in ascending or descending order?
Is the sorting based on lexicographic order (dictionary order) or some other criterion like length?
If sorting lexicographically, is it case-sensitive? (All strings are lowercase, so this is already answered.)
Should the strings be sorted by their length, given that all lengths are distinct?
What should happen if two strings are identical? (This cannot occur due to distinct lengths.)
Is the input guaranteed to have exactly N strings, and should we validate that N matches the number of strings provided?
Should the concatenation include any separator between the sorted strings?
If sorting lexicographically, should it use the default Python sorting (which is lexicographic based on Unicode code points)?
